title: Hoshino Ichika — The Vow In My Heart〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
And the sky's super clear. This means...

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Wait, there's another one!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's hurry over to the park.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're right.
I thought there was gonna be a ton of people here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, a bunch of people at those condos over there are out watching from their balconies. Everyone might be staying home for this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
That must be nice, like having your own VIP section.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Aren't you forgetting about our VIP section?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, let's climb up the jungle gym♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, need me to push you up like when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I can climb up all by myself now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm up.
That was definitely easier than back then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because we're big girls now♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's great and all...
But it feels pretty cramped up here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It does...
Here, I'll move more towards the middle.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't seen a single shooting star since that last one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me neither, but let's try to be patient.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then, let's switch seats!
We can sit where we all did way back when we saw the Leonid meteor shower!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, you were at the very top!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Saki, Honami, you two were next to me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Shiho sat one rung below, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You all remember?
So... Oh, I think I was sitting here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Watch your step, okay?
If it feels like you're going to fall, it might be better to climb down and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be fine♪ You're already in the middle, so lemme borrow your hand for a second!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here. You be careful too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I just saw a shooting star...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Near that building to the right—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I just saw one over that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We should call Miku and the others over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku? Can you all hear us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<How's the meteor shower?
Have you seen any shooting stars yet?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're just starting to see more and... Oh, look! There!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, there's another! Whoa! And another one over there?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <This park is where you all came when you were little, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we climbed on top of this jungle gym to watch the Leonid meteor shower.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki made a wish that time hoping we'd be together forever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because of you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really doubt we alone would've been able to make her wish come true.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. What if the shooting stars you saw that time were the reason why her wish came true?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You saw a meteor shower that time, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If those shooting stars did make that wish come true, I feel like they gave us too much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because we even got to meet you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're just glad that those feelings belonged to such wonderful people.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi, Miku!
Let's see who can spot the most shooting stars!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I could ask you the same.
